mapper.insert:
insert into video
id, user_id, category_id, title, description, play_url, cover_url, duration, play_count, like_count, comment_count, share_count, status, handler_id,
values
#{id}, #{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{playUrl}, #{coverUrl}, #{duration}, #{playCount}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{shareCount}, #{status}, #{handlerId},
mapper.delete: delete from video where user_id = #{userId} and id != #{videoId}
mapper.select: select v.id as videoId, v.user_id as userId, u.nickname as nickName, u.avatar_url, v.category_id as categoryId, v.title, v.play_url as playUrl, v.cover_url as coverUrl, v.duration, v.like_count as likeCount, if(vl.video_id is not null, true, false) as isLiked, v.comment_count as commentCount, v.share_count as shareCount, v.created_time as createdTime from video v left join user_high u on v.user_id = u.id left join video_like vl on v.id = vl.video_id and vl.user_id = #{userId} where v.id < #{lastId} and v.status = 1 order by v.id desc limit #{size}
